review_evidence: README identifies the project as Lean implementations of material from Certified Programming with Dependent Types.

The Cpdt tree contains typed and untyped language semantics, compiler-correctness theorems, inductive predicates, a verified typechecker, domain-theoretic computation/fixpoint results, well-founded mergesort, and length-indexed/tagless constructions.
Complete inspection shows Main.lean is only `def main : IO Unit := pure ()` and lakefile.lean is only Lake package/library configuration; all CPDT formal content remains in retained Cpdt modules.

rules.content_invariant: Main.lean is an empty IO program and lakefile.lean only declares the Lake package/library target; every CPDT definition, statement, and proof remains in retained Cpdt modules.
evidence: All substantive Cpdt modules and FD-016 navigation roots remain retained.
rules.rationale: These exact files are executable/build scaffolding rather than CPDT formalization.

summary: Retain the CPDT formal development and exclude only its empty executable stub and Lake build configuration.
